 1               P R O C E E D I N G S

 2                ACTING PRESIDENT CROCI:  The Senate 

 3   will come to order.  

 4                I ask everyone present to please 

 5   rise and repeat with me the Pledge of 

 6   Allegiance.

 7                (Whereupon, the assemblage recited 

 8   the Pledge of Allegiance to the Flag.)

 9                ACTING PRESIDENT CROCI:  Today we 

10   have the Reverend Peter G. Young, from 

11   Mother Teresa Community, Albany, to deliver our 

12   invocation.

13                REVEREND YOUNG:   Thank you, 

14   Senator.  

15                Let us pray.  

16                By being a Senator, you have 

17   accepted and been accepted into the leadership 

18   position so that you can more fully serve the 

19   people of New York State.  In the spirit of 

20   community, our prayer today will be to be better 

21   able to achieve the goal of dedicated 

22   representation in the power that is entrusted to 

23   all of our legislators and to the leadership of 

24   this community in the Senate.  May you attain 

25   your satisfaction in your services for all of 


                                                                201

 1   your constituents.  

 2                And may we especially prepare today 

 3   to remember a prayer for Martin Luther King and 

 4   the good work of his dedication.  Having enjoyed 

 5   being with him on many an occasion, enjoying the 

 6   opportunity of listening to his words of wisdom 

 7   in the March on Washington in the year '63, I 

 8   identify myself as an old-timer.  

 9                Amen.

10                ACTING PRESIDENT CROCI:   The 

11   reading of the Journal.
